title: Cross-scale information incrementality falsification contract
purpose: Prevent multi-timeframe pattern agreement from being counted as independent evidence unless it adds a causal state not recoverable as a deterministic restatement of the same PRICE_OHLC path.

DETERMINISTIC_RESTATEMENT.rule: Higher/lower scale labels whose pivots, boundaries, triggers and confirmation clocks are deterministically recoverable from the same causal lower-scale prefix are one evidence family.

TOPOLOGY_REVEAL.rule: Aggregation may reveal a stable containment, hierarchy, duration or compression state not represented by one lower-scale object. Preserve as a distinct state descriptor, but do not call it independent alpha evidence.

INDEPENDENT_PROVENANCE.rule: A genuinely separate PIT provenance lane may add evidence, but D01 must reference the dependency rather than double-count another domain's maturity.

promotionGuards: No forward returns may be used to define or choose these classes.
TOPOLOGY_REVEAL is not an alpha claim.
Named-pattern count is not independent-evidence count.
UNKNOWN is never coerced to zero or failure.
Any later economic test must control existing momentum, volatility contraction, close location and prior-high distance before claiming incremental value.
nextContinuationPoint: Build a pure classifier and synthetic tests for CSI01-CSI08 on this research-only branch; require true-prefix equality and semantic-space guards before any outcome study.
